name: Cogwheel
summary:
Welcome to the world of mechanical Cogwheel! This you have not seen in the AppStore!

Arcade game with unique gameplay, easy only at first sight story and challenging levels are sure to impress even the most demanding fans to have fun! Help the little gear wheel overcome all obstacles in its path! Move the blocks, turn away from the magnets, do everything possible! Do not forget to increase oil level, because you need the strength to go through the wall between the levels!

Do not think that to keep gear is easy! We promise that you will spend time in exciting adventure!
